manual_review_reason: SoundChat Radio's dedicated first-party form requests artist and contact details, track title, genre, a SoundCloud, Spotify, YouTube or direct-download link, release context, and an ownership and broadcast-permission affirmation. A human must select a suitable clean or radio-ready MarcsMusic release, verify link accessibility, metadata and rights, confirm international eligibility, release timing and AI-origin policy, inspect the live form for CAPTCHA, anti-spam, session, consent or payment controls, and submit manually. The general contact form, info@SoundChatRadio.com, irishandchin@gmail.com, listener request lines, advertising, airtime, donation, shop and social routes must not be used as submission substitutes.
